scope: Narrow fixed pre-ready setup checkpoint and trusted first-frame category diagnostics. Generic secure-origin label is a first-frame mismatch, not proof of a secureDocument failure.
invariants: No protocol fields, frame order, status/exit codes, error labels, cleanup ACK, retries or existing timer/deadline constants are changed.
All fields are fixed allowlisted stages/categories, bounded monotonic ages and configured-budget facts; no raw error, path, credential, ID, native payload or variable URL output.

Node checkpoints only observe. No new timers or runtime success/failure gates. Existing temporary-scope/browser launch five-second shared budget, connect/navigation twenty-second configured budget, Rust readiness twenty-five seconds and cleanup fifteen-plus-fifteen seconds remain.

Configured-budget elapsed means observed monotonic time since shared launch budget start or immediately before connect/navigation call; it does not diagnose the SDK exception or independently establish its internal timeout clock. Operations without explicit current timeout report null budget/elapsed.
Rust first-frame classification happens after existing version/sequence validation and prints no received frame. Existing error string is preserved.

Existing bounded stderr owner retains512 bytes; only strictly typed bounded diagnostics are parsed. Constructor setup metadata is emitted even when its cleanup succeeds. Failed/missing diagnostic is absence of evidence, never a new success.
600000ms diagnostic age cap retains explicit age_capped flag; it does not add a600000ms execution budget.
Source freeze remains until root full125 gate is terminal. Runtime reproduction is root-owned after independent source acceptance.
remaining_required: Independent paired source review before any root application.
Root-owned actual reproduction to observe first frame category/setup checkpoint.
Fresh final-source gate and source bindings if root applies candidate.
